joint_uncertainty.method: aligned whole-batch delete-one jackknife; all weights/support recomputed
joint_uncertainty.point_estimator: pooled plug-in; no jackknife bias correction
joint_uncertainty.dependence: four probes share one prefix; all six metrics share one new block

interpretation: The primary tests one safe-step completion-creation mean at fixed exact (D,nu_b).
Derived edge and two-step-survival contrasts use cell-specific s before aggregation.
Secondary exact-D nu replication is independent of the old block, not of this primary.
A null weighted moment can hide cell cancellation and does not establish recursive closure.
Finite square L512 insertion clock only; no limiting, label-clock, or universality claim.
No historical data pooling, subgroup search, fitted exponent, or acquisition is performed.

contract_document.cutoff_source: unchanged old square-L512 count cutoffs, as in completion-hazard-production-20260929
contract_document.primary: overlap-weighted early-minus-late mean safe-insertion completion increment Y within exact (primitive direction,integer nu_b)
contract_document.primary_eligibility: nu_b<N-b; cells with nu_b=N-b have no safe conditional step and are separately counted
contract_document.sampling: independent uniform site permutations; four with-replacement uniform safe-site probes in separate copies of each rank-one prefix, selected by vacancy rejection using a distinct RNG stream
contract_document.probe_unit: one original prefix; average its four increments before inference, never treat them as independent configurations
contract_document.weights: w=n_early*n_late/(n_early+n_late) on common exact cells; normalize over cells and recompute all support and weights on aligned whole-batch deletion
contract_document.mechanistic_map: in each cell, Delta mean e=(N-b-nu_b)*DeltaY/2, Delta two-step survival=-(N-b-nu_b)*DeltaY/[(N-b)*(N-b-1)]
contract_document.secondary: independent replication of the previously retrospective exact-direction weighted mean nu_b contrast; all rank-one prefixes, including any with no safe step
contract_document.model_prediction: (rank,direction,nu) weak Markov closure requires the primary cohort contrast to be zero. Nonzero population contrast violates a necessary condition; an unresolved contrast does not establish full closure. No prospective sign assumed from L4 because square/triangular signs differ.
contract_document.analysis: one fixed primary mean; full aligned 14-batch delete-one covariance with derived edge/two-step contrasts and declared secondary; no old/new pooling, cutoff/feature/subgroup search, result-dependent sample extension, or exponent fitting
contract_document.benchmark: 32 new excluded prefixes, runtime only, separate seed role; anticipated ideal-parallel production time must not exceed 900 seconds to start this block
contract_document.scope: one lattice, one existing size and count clock; no direct finite-window-survival replacement, original-U identification or continuum certificate
